text:
mia: Quick check — planning a customer demo Wed 03:00 UTC, need 6x A100s (short 2hr window). Can we confirm availability in asia-east1? Who can grab serials/slot?
raj: I can try to carve from the demo pool, but current soft-hold shows 4 free only. Vendor ETA on extra racks is fuzzy. :thinking_face:
yvonne: FYI finance flagged extra standby rent if we stretch beyond the soft-hold. Prefer keep to 4 unless absolutely needed.
mia: Understood. If we only get 4 we may need to shorten the demo or fall back to h100 mix. Is there perf risk for our LLMs on mixed sku?
raj: Mixed H100/A100 is okay for single-model inference but throughput will vary. For a 2hr demo it's fine if we route heavier flows to A100. Ops can set model routing.
ops-bot: Allocation request created: alloc-1735802468 by @raj -> status: pending vendor confirm. (alloc details: region=asia-east1, requested=6xA100, window=2024-05-08T03:00Z..2024-05-08T05:00Z)
ben: Quick ask — can you paste the terraform snippet we need to claim the standby? I can submit PR and ping vendor team.
raj: snippet: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_alloc" "demo" {
  region = "asia-east1"
  gpu_count = 6
  gpu_type = "a100-40gb"
  window_start = "2024-05-08T03:00Z"
  window_end = "2024-05-08T05:00Z"
}
```
ben: thanks. I'll open PR now and add a note about finance cost center.
mia: If vendor only confirms 4, plan B: we shorten interactive session and route non-critical queries to cached responses. Can ops set a fallback routing policy?
raj: yes — can add a simple policy: prefer A100 pool, fallback to h100-mix with 2s added latency allowance. I can add that to the rollout config.
yvonne: Also tag the charge to demo-cc-42 so finance can approve standby rent quickly.
ops-bot: Vendor update: vendor-team@cloudpartner replied — extra rack delivery delayed ~18 hours, confirm allocation will be 4xA100.
mia: Ok thanks. We'll proceed with 4 and do the shorter demo. Ben/raj, please finalize PR + routing fallback by EOD PST. :thumbsup:
ben: on it. PR #482 opened -> link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
raj: routing config PR queued, adding the fallback policy and cache TTL tweak.
yvonne: finance noted — demo-cc-42 approved for up to $600 standby if needed.
mia: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and confirm time still works.
ben: quick FYI — serials will be posted in the allocation ticket once vendor finalizes.
ops-bot: Allocation alloc-1735802468 status updated -> confirmed: 4xA100 (serials pending).
